sections.h2: Other digital marketing services in Kochi
Frequently Asked Questions — Content Marketing Agency Kochi

items.q: What does a content marketing agency in Kochi do?
items.a: A content marketing agency plans, writes and publishes content that brings the right customers to your business. At Teknoppy that means content strategy, a publishing calendar, SEO-led blogs and articles, long-form guides, and monthly reports on traffic, rankings and enquiries.

items.q: How much does content marketing cost in Kochi?
items.a: Most Kochi businesses pay between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 50,000 per month. The price depends on how many articles you need, how deep each one goes, and how much industry research is required. We share a written quote before work starts.

items.q: How long does content marketing take to show results?
items.a: Most businesses see meaningful traffic growth in 3 to 6 months. Search engines need time to find, index and rank new content, and results build as more articles are published and linked together. Paid ads are faster, but traffic stops when the budget stops.

items.q: How is content marketing different from SEO?
items.a: Content marketing is the planning and creation of useful content such as blogs, guides and articles. SEO is the wider work, including technical fixes and on-page optimization, that helps your whole site rank. We build content with SEO in mind, but they are separate services.

Consistency matters more than volume. A realistic schedule you can keep, such as a few strong articles each month, beats a burst of posts followed by silence. We set the schedule during content calendar planning, based on your budget and goals.

items.q: Do you offer B2B content marketing?
items.a: Yes. B2B content must build trust with several decision-makers over a longer buying cycle. We research your industry and buyers first, then write guides and articles that answer the questions they ask before contacting a supplier.

items.q: Do you handle strategy or only writing?
items.a: Both. Strategy comes first so every article has a clear purpose, audience and keyword target. We can also write to an existing strategy if your team already has one defined.

items.q: How do I choose a content marketing agency in Kochi?
items.a: Ask to see published work and results, check who will write and edit your content, and ask how topics are researched. Look for clear pricing and monthly reporting. Avoid agencies that promise page-one rankings by a fixed date.

items.q: Will content marketing help my Google Ads?
items.a: Yes, indirectly. Strong content supports landing page quality and gives you material for remarketing and social promotion, so paid campaigns and content work together.

items.q: Do you optimize content for ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity?
items.a: Yes. We write clear, question-led sections with checkable facts so AI tools can quote them accurately. No agency can guarantee citations, but clear structure and trustworthy sources improve your chances.
